### Reference: settings and attachments

#### `setting`

function · `import { setting } from '@harness/sdk'`

Declare an actor setting.

```ts
function setting<T>(def: { description: string; type: GinType<T>; appliesTo: ActorKind[]; merge: SettingMerge; editableBy?: SettingEditor[]; }): SettingDef<T>;
```

Refers to: [`ActorKind`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-actorkind), [`SettingEditor`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.manifestpatch#core-settingeditor), [`SettingMerge`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.manifestpatch#core-settingmerge).

#### `SettingDef`

interface · `import { SettingDef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A typed control admins (or fns) attach to actors. A run reads the effective value with `ctx.setting(ref)`.

```ts
interface SettingDef<T> {
  readonly description: string;
  readonly type: GinType<T>;
  readonly appliesTo: readonly ActorKind[];
  /** How a user's value combines with their groups'. */
  readonly merge: SettingMerge;
  /** Besides admins, who may set it. */
  readonly editableBy: readonly SettingEditor[];
}
```

Refers to: [`ActorKind`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-actorkind), [`SettingEditor`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.manifestpatch#core-settingeditor), [`SettingMerge`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.manifestpatch#core-settingmerge).

#### `SettingRef`

interface · `import { SettingRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A typed handle to an actor setting. `ctx.setting(fs.settings.shell)` returns its typed value.

```ts
interface SettingRef<N extends QualifiedName, T> {
  readonly ref: 'setting';
  readonly name: N;
  readonly type: GinType<T>;
}
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-qualifiedname).

#### `attachment`

function · `import { attachment } from '@harness/sdk'`

Declare an attachment kind.

```ts
function attachment<T>(def: { description: string; data: GinType<T>; }): AttachmentDef<T>;
```

#### `AttachmentDef`

interface · `import { AttachmentDef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A kind of attachment a system's fns add to assistant messages, drawn by its client renderer.

```ts
interface AttachmentDef<T> {
  readonly description: string;
  readonly data: GinType<T>;
}
```

#### `AttachmentRef`

interface · `import { AttachmentRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A typed handle to an attachment kind. `ctx.attach(fs.attachments.diff, data, title)` checks the data.

```ts
interface AttachmentRef<N extends QualifiedName, T> {
  readonly ref: 'attachment';
  readonly name: N;
  readonly data: GinType<T>;
}
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-qualifiedname).
